<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Ticketing" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/ticketing">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_SearchRequest" name="Ticket search request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RouteSelection" name="Route, date and time selection"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PassengerDetails" name="Personal and payment details"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_TicketDelivery" name="Ticket delivery (email or SMS)"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_TravelReminder" name="Travel reminder and check-in or boarding instructions"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_JourneyCompleted" name="Journey completed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Feedback" name="Post-travel feedback"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_Ticketing">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_TravelCompany" name="Travel Company" processRef="Process_TravelCompany"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Search" name="Ticket search" messageRef="Msg_SearchRequest" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Search"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RouteSelection" name="Route, date and time" messageRef="Msg_RouteSelection" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSelection"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PassengerDetails" name="Personal and payment details" messageRef="Msg_PassengerDetails" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDetails"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_TicketDelivery" name="Ticket" messageRef="Msg_TicketDelivery" sourceRef="Task_SendTicket" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_TravelReminder" name="Reminder and instructions" messageRef="Msg_TravelReminder" sourceRef="Task_SendReminder" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_JourneyCompleted" name="Journey completed" messageRef="Msg_JourneyCompleted" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Event_JourneyCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Feedback" name="Post-travel feedback" messageRef="Msg_Feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelCompany" name="Travel Company Ticketing" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Search" name="Ticket search received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Search" messageRef="Msg_SearchRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSelection" name="Receive route, date and time selection" messageRef="Msg_RouteSelection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDetails" name="Receive personal and payment details" messageRef="Msg_PassengerDetails">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTicket" name="Send ticket to customer via email or SMS" messageRef="Msg_TicketDelivery">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update seat inventory">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReminder" name="Send reminder and check-in or boarding instructions" messageRef="Msg_TravelReminder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_JourneyCompleted" name="Journey completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_JourneyCompleted" messageRef="Msg_JourneyCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" name="Feedback or post-travel service?" default="Flow_NoFeedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoFeedback</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Feedback</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveFeedback" name="Receive post-travel feedback" messageRef="Msg_Feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Feedback</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackJoin" name="Feedback path merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoFeedback</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Completed" name="Booking process completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Search" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSelection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSelection" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDetails" targetRef="Task_GenerateTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_GenerateTicket" targetRef="Task_SendTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_SendTicket" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Task_SendReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_SendReminder" targetRef="Event_JourneyCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Event_JourneyCompleted" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoFeedback" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">Feedback or post-travel service requested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_Completed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
